[[File:Rryatt_Trail_Rebel_camp.jpg|thumb|350px|The Rebel camp.]]
The '''Rebel camp''' was the base of operations of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando unit]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], homeworld of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. The camp was hidden on the [[Rryatt Trail#The Common Paths|Common Paths]] level of the dangerous [[Rryatt Trail]].

As of [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], the camp consisted of a small guard tower, an unfinished reinforced wall and various tents. A [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] was parked on a small hill next to the camp. The Rebels used a [[CLL-8 binary load lifter]] to move crates and heavy equipment around.

Right next to the camp one could find a small Wookiee burial ground.
